test_waveform_to_fbank_converter_basic: test the WaveformToFbankConverter to convert audio waveform to fbank features with channel_last=True
test_waveform_to_fbank_converter_standar: test the WaveformToFbankConverter with standardize=True to normalize fbank output to zero mean and unit std
test_waveform_to_fbank_converter_keep_wa: test the WaveformToFbankConverter with keep_waveform=True to preserve the original waveform in output
test_waveform_to_fbank_converter_dtype: test the WaveformToFbankConverter with a custom dtype like torch.float64 for fbank output
test_waveform_to_fbank_converter_error_h: test the WaveformToFbankConverter error handling for invalid input types, missing keys, and wrong sample rates
